info.title: CopaLibre API
info.description:
Self-hosted tournament management API.

Authentication is JWT Bearer, validated against the operator-selected
identity provider’s JWKS. Browsers use Authorization Code + PKCE and
hold the access token in memory only — never localStorage. A token
passed as a query parameter is ignored, because URLs leak into proxy
logs, browser history, metrics, traces and screenshots.

Every route declares one security plane: public-read,
authenticated-interaction, admin-control, or integration.
authenticated-interaction and admin-control share this same bearer
transport and differ only in authorization policy.

bearer.description: Short-lived access token. Strict stateless mode is the default: no refresh credential is persisted, so a reload reauthenticates.

role.description: Process role this instance is running as
Process role this instance is running as

schemaVersion.description: Applied database schema version this release requires

organizationAlias.description: Human-readable, URL-safe alias; globally unique per installation

role.description: The caller's active role in this organization

message.example: subject may only act on their own records

alias.description: Human-readable, URL-safe alias; globally unique per installation

primaryLanguage.description: Presentation-layer default interface language; never reinterprets stored data

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier; presentation-layer default only

alias.description: Lowercase kebab-case alias, unique per installation

primaryLanguage.description: Defaults to "es" (matches this installation's current default behavior) when omitted

timezone.description: IANA time zone identifier; defaults to "UTC" when omitted

status.description: Once started, the tournament's discipline and profile versions are frozen and its results are materialised. Archived is legal only from finished (0033) and changes default visibility only — no data is affected.

startedAt.description: When the first match began, marking the module freeze.

archivedAt.description: When the tournament was archived (0033); absent until then.

rulesetId.description: Active ruleset version, when one exists

descriptorVersion.description: Pinned descriptor version (semver). Rulesets never track "latest": the version a tournament starts on is frozen.

publicRegistration.description: Whether anonymous/public registration intake is open for this tournament.

requiresCheckIn.description: Whether accepted entrants must check in before eligibility is locked.

checkInClosesAt.description: Optional instant when checked-in team memberships stop being editable.

reason.description: Recorded on the audit row. A refusal an entrant cannot be told about is one they will ask about.

refused.description: Registrations left untouched, each with the reason — never silently skipped.

supportedFormats.description: Formats this discipline declares it supports. The client filters from this list rather than from its own copy — a hardcoded list is a list that disagrees with the module the day one is added.

startsAt.description: Start of the reserved window, epoch milliseconds

durationMinutes.description: How long the resource is reserved — not how long the match takes

minimumMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between an entrant's consecutive fixtures

resourceId.description: Venue, official or entrant the clash is about

detail.description: Human-readable explanation an operator can act on

committable.description: Whether the batch would publish as it stands

affectedPublishedFixtures.description: Already-published fixtures this batch would move

clockRunning.description: Whether the active segment’s clock is running

runningTimers.description: Timers still running, by event id

score.description: Score folded from the immutable event log

statistics.description: Declared statistic deltas folded from the event log

durationSeconds.description: Descriptor-declared duration for a timed segment

startedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the causing event

remainingSeconds.description: Derived at read; never a stored countdown

result.description: Resolved authoritative result when one exists

eligiblePersonIds.description: Persons eligible for attribution from active match rosters

eligibleStaffIds.description: Coaches and staff attached to an entrant contesting this match

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted to this subject for this match

sides.description: One entry per side: entrant id, its declared statistics, and placement for a heat

activate.description: Make the selected segment the active clock segment

definitionCode.description: Event definition code the discipline declares

side.description: The entrant it belongs to — an id, never "home"/"away"

personId.description: The person, when the discipline needs one

sequence.description: Monotonic per-match ordering assigned by the log

notifications.description: Identity keys of notifications this event declared, deduplicated on delivery

reason.description: Why the result is being corrected, in the operator’s words

sides.description: The replacement result, one entry per side

sourceReportId.description: A participant report or dispute this correction cites (0032) — retained as supporting evidence in the audit trail. Citing one grants no authority of its own.

blockedPropagation.description: Present when a started downstream stage is deliberately not rebuilt

corrections.description: Oldest first — the chain, in order

sourceCsv.description: UTF-8 CopaLibre participant CSV, limited to 4 MiB.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 source fingerprint used to reject stale confirmation.
Source hash returned by the reviewed preview.

rank.description: 1-based; rows sharing a rank were not separated

sharedRank.description: True when another row holds the same rank

statistics.description: Exactly the statistics the bound discipline declares, keyed by code

tieBroken.description: True when a tiebreak comparator had to separate this row; the screen shows the trace expander only for these

projectionVersion.description: Generation of the standings projection; 0 before the first rebuild

fullyResolved.description: False when a tie survived every declared comparator

trace.description: The rules engine’s explanation trace for the whole calculation, rendered verbatim
example: Rule 1 (Puntos): a=13, b=13 → Tie not fully resolved by Puntos

lines.description: Empty when no comparator had to separate this entrant

matchId.description: Match this slot sources its participant from

score.description: Score recorded for this side, when the match is finalized

format.description: Declared match format, e.g. BO3 — absent when the stage declares none

hasRecordedResults.description: True once any match in this stage has a recorded result

seeds.description: The full seed order, not a delta — a partial order is an ambiguous bracket

reason.description: Why the change was classified this way

invalidates.description: Fixture ids this change invalidates; empty unless it requires a rebuild

persisted.description: True once the new seed order and fixture graph are durably persisted. Always true for a 200 response — a publish that could not persist refuses with 409 instead of returning a partial success.

matchId.description: Pins the device to one match, not the full tournament rotation

label.description: Operator-facing device label, e.g. "Cancha 1 - TV entrada"

token.description: Shown once. Provision the device with it; it is never stored raw.

url.description: The /tv/** launch URL to configure on the device

statistics.description: Statistic values by code, as the participant saw them

proposedResult.description: What the participant believes the result was

validationStatus.description: pending, passed, or failed — set by the async validation job

reason.description: Why the recorded result is being disputed

status.description: reviewed or dismissed — never applies a correction by itself
